[*][b]Snooker rules fixes.[/b]

[*][b]Other minor bug fixes, [/b]
[*][b]Anti-aliasing improvements[/b]

*We're a small team, these translations may not be perfect and its important to us that we get it right - so please do let us know if there are areas we can improve on.

notes.title: Update: 25/1/2016
notes.content:
We have been working on a number of fixes this week based on your feedback, below is a patch list for this update which will go live today:

[list]
[*]Fixes to improve stability
[*]Fix for wrong table physics being loaded sometimes
[*]Fix for online games becoming locked to 'private'
[*]Allow shot timer options for friendlies and Play For Cash
[*]Added 'collection' button to main menu
[*]Fix for 'claim frame' in online snooker games.
[*]Closed loophole for people quitting out of games and not being penalised
[*]Fixed display on HUD with high number of frames
[*]Play for cash games are not restricted to the Pool Hall location
[*]New XP progress bar  on profile HUD
[*]New Flashback triggering mechanism
[*]Fix issue with players cash dropping below $0
[*]Post match screen timer increased by 5 seconds
[*]Fix for practice hints changing too soon
[*]New tour hoardings shown when playing in the tour
player 2 can now play using controller 2 in local 2 player games (There will be further improments to this in the next update) [/list] 

[i]*If your posted issue isn't on this list I will post a current priorities list shortly for this week, so please do report it in that thread if you feel it has been missed and needs urgent attention.[/i]

Thanks again for your continued support, and don't forget if you like what we do please write a review :)

notes.title: Only being able to practice in the F2P Lite version was a bug
notes.content:
We have been notified of the ability to ONLY practice in the FREE version, this should not be the case, however to those of you who downloaded Pool Nation FX on or after the 14th December this is all you would have access to - THIS IS A BUG AND IS NOW FIXED. 

We apologise greatly for the confusion here, and can confirm this is now fixed. However if you ever experience such situation again please do get in touch. 

To help improve the online experience we have made a number of updates in this patch including the ability for F2P gamers to join all available matches in the pool hall* - this should provide much more variety and a better experience all-round. *For a limited time only

[h1]Also in the patch are the following updates: [/h1]
[list]
[*]LITE players can now JOIN any online game type of Full Game user 
*Available on a trial basis for a limited time only
*The create match ability stays as was for lite users, you cannot create a match using locked content, this should provide 'full gamer' users more match opportunities and a better online experience all round
[*]Fixed issue with cue distance being set for host instead of client
[*]New 'Screen percentage' graphics option that reduces in game resolution while keeping UI resolution the same.
[*]Fixed issue with shots being skipped when you select 'Resume' on pause menu
[*]Improved visibility of tour challenges
[*]Fixed issue with 'not in the correct league' message box showing incorrect info
[*]Fixed issue with cash not being awarded correctly when levelling up
[*]New camera option to view AI shots in free cam mode
[*]Fix issue with clients losing cash after restarting the game from online matches
[*]Play for Cash matches now play in the user's currently set location, not the Pool Hall every time
[*]New pop up screens to help in navigation the menus and online 
[*]A key in the online menu for ease of use 
[*]New default US 8Ball rule to match official WPA rules (can pot opponents ball if you have hit a legal ball first)
[*]Settings are now accessible from the practice game
[*]Improved the Manual camera to make it smoother
[*]Fix for issue on collection page where number of unlocked decals was shown incorrectly
[*]Fix for game modes not being unlocked for some new users

Thank you again for your feedback and support and for helping us get to the bottom of this 'Practice Only' bug. 

[i]*Additions to the game in our updates do not have to be a permanent decision, if you as a communiy feel an addition/update doesn't work to provide a better online experience for all we will look at changing/amending it based on community feedback[/i]

notes.title: 12 Days Of a Cherry Pop Christmas...
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/401182814312757311/3091112FD5BF6C23CB4410C2D70497221FBED676/[/img]

[h1]A new mode unlocked every day...[/h1]

Today we are celebrating the start of [b]12 days of a Cherry Pop Christmas	[/b], where each day we will unlock for 24 hours a new game mode to play online for our F2P friends, this means that you get a glimpse of what else is in the game for you to unlock and also the chance to earn more coins and (XP) experience points, which in turn earns you more coins! Yey! 

This is also a Merry Christmas to our loyal fans who want a variety of game types played in the pool hall, so guys play these modes, practice your skills, experiment with various aiming aids, try turning the aiming off and enjoy playing Pool Nation FX this festive season! 

So, pool playing gamers, head forth to Pool Nation FX each day and unlock your free mode and play all day until a new mode is unlocked! 

Have a very Merry Holiday Season, and we look forward to hearing you ideas and suggestions to build Pool Nation FX into the best pool game ever made, together we can make digital billiards history :) 

	
[b][i]HO HO HO Merry Christmas![/i][/b]

tags.feature: - A new mode unlocked every day...

notes.title: Pool Nation FX - Lite NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Yesterday saw the launch of Pool Nation FX out of Early access in a new format to help build the online community. 

[h1]We have split the game into three sections: [/h1]

[h1]The LITE (free) version, which includes:[/h1]

The ability to play online, but [u]only 8 ball Pool[/u], Play for Cash games with the lowest prize fund. And create match games. 
You can practice 8ball, 9ball or Snooker offline. NOT against the AI. This is a practice mode to hone your skills
You cannot play online friendlies, leagues etc, or any of the other rules sets (9ball, snooker, etc)
You are locked to a single aiming aid level (Standard AKA Pro aiming aid). But the rest of the Aiming Aids (lines) are unlockable by coins you can earn in game

[h1]The Offline Pack inlcludes: [/h1]
ALL 11 Game types offline, including Speed, Killer & Snooker
All Aiming Aids unlocked
The full offline career - in 8 Ball, Snooker and 9 Ball
Endurance Mode, a fast paced race against the clock mode
The full customisable trickshot editor 
Local multiplayer mode: Versus.
Fully customisable Rules 

[h1]The Online Pack inlcludes: [/h1]
ALL 11 Game types online, including Speed, Killer & Snooker
All Aiming Aids unlocked
Full Play For Cash Career where you start at $25 prize fund and work up to $100,000 
Leagues Online - in 8 Ball, Snooker and 9 Ball
Friendlies Online - where you can create a private lobby to play with friends
Fully customisable Rules 

I know this is a BIG step and there is lots more to do in game as DOUBLES are being introduced soon :) 
But we wanted to come out of early Access as really, the game is beyond that point, and we want to help build the online community for you... But it doesn't change anything there is still lots more to come! :) 

Thanks again guys and I cannot wait to unleash the next big  update on you 

CPx

notes.title: [11/18/2015] Updating getting ready for full launch...
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397801945129439255/29562F26A1C1E43258E70279AF0FED84065B0903/[/img]

[h1]Updated Pool Hall menus with added ability to change aiming aid and location clearly:[/h1] 
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397801945129438841/4238963EF12975981426B2AEC53DE07619C0C72C/[/img]

[h1]Updated Snooker centre pockets:[/h1]
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397801945129455515/64B2CF33AC57EACF8BFC33DA7C040328B8EA3159/[/img]

Thank you again Team EA for all your suggestions and help with bug fixes, below is a full list of patch notes for this update. 

I must add as a note we have updated 2 variety of Snooker table pockets for you to test out; 
- Manchester, Pool Hall & VIP have a championship table pockets center and corner (these are slightly more forgiving pockets than previously) 
- Hawaii, Japan, Sweden and New York have the new championship centre pockets and slightly tighter corner pockets which reflect the correct dimensions of a championship table.

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1] 
Updated all rooms with improved lighting
Updated snooker table pockets
Fix for lobby bug when skipping flythrough
Stop scores updating in trickshot replays
Push to talk now enabled (on 'C' key)
Fixes for incorrect avatars being displayed online
Force continue enabled for fouls in snooker
Force retake for foul and a miss in snooker
Updated snooker respotting to respot balls closer to blocked spots
V.I.P room re-enabled alongside the new pool hall
Checks to prevent people cheating online (quitting out etc)
Fixed text chat staying up and blocking controls when using controller
First set of controls remapping enabled
Fixes for spectating league matches
New camera control. Raise up/down on arrow keys
Mouse acceleration can now be configured on the options menu
Fix for crash entering a game as spectator if host was in pause menu
Free cam enabled in trickshot
Hide HUD option added
Fix for rare occurance of lights being off in in pool for client
Fix for snooker points awarded when balls are forced off table
New search parameters for online games (location, time of day, table)
Fixed spectators not having correct decal on table
Fix for forfeiting player's score being 0 if they forfeit the frame in snooker

notes.title: [10/29/2015] Introducing the Pool Hall
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397800674094438446/1063B9DF595963AEC968367AFD52A398FFF21D76/[/img]

[b] This update see's the Introduction of the first stage of the Pool Hall, a living online pool experience, bringing digital pool to life...[/b] 

[h1]The Pool Hall Menu[/h1] 


The Pool Hall is much more than an online menu. This is the online hub where all online matches are displayed, joined, created and edited in one place. Live updates of the table state are displayed, so this menu itself feels alive. 

This is only the first stage of the pool hall experience, soon you will be able to spectate matches, join in group chat, play winner stays on and more.  

[h1]A New way to create a match[/h1] 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397800674094452691/5A5FD03D74C20160EF6EF7572BC13852CC4E1954/[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=543510147
From one menu you can create and edit your matches, all while watching for new matches to join the pool hall - never miss a match again. 

[h1]The new pool hall venue[/h1]

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397800674094455315/5981A382517C054951CE744B579BB2899CFD8A3B/[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=543510604
The Pool Hall implementation in its first stage is not just a new online menu experience we have also created a new online venue. 

[h1]Snooker Rules Updated[/h1]
Include: 
Spotting balls correctly 
Baulk colours spotted correctly 
Updated points accounted correctly on a foul 

[h1]Table friction in Snooker and Pool [/h1]
We have altered the table friction before the implementation of the slider to ensure the default speeds we are working on feel correct this has been updated for Snooker and Pool 

[h1][u]Full Patch Notes:[/u] 
- Snooker players now break correctly, playing a proper snooker break. 
- Mute/unmute hints when using controller
- Accepting invite from main menu no longer disables the controller
- Hot swapping between mouse/kb enabled throughout
- Resolution options filled from list of resolutions supported by the monitor
- Endurance best time now retrieved when going to endurance menu
- Removed hints from overhead view
- Can now choose from 3 different 'watch' camera types
- Disabled text chat in single player
- Fixes for graphics menu not working correctly with controller
- Brand new online Map.  The pool hall.
- Fixed an issue with drawing double info on tour win when we had endurance bonus match
- Fixed horrible noise playing sometimes when a ball is entering a pocket
- Increased speed of tables and started the basics for implementing a table - speed option
- Update drop stop music correctly if we foul/restart endurance.
- Reduced the occurrence of the random crash bug.
- Fixed issue with preferences being lost if you play in offline mode
- Prize fund now drawn on HUD when in Play For Cash
- Respotting balls in snooker now follows official snooker rules
- Player can now claim the frame when they are on black and >7 points ahead in snooker
- Hitting reds on two consecutive shots now gives 7 points away instead of 4.
- Endurance sound/music coming back when fouling in drop stop.
- New resolutions listing.
- Controller speeds on some menus.
- New follow ball camera.
- New game mode in pool hall to create match and easily play with aiming aid off.[/h1]

notes.title: Pool Nation FX is out Now
notes.content:
Hey guys thanks for all your support Pool Nation FX is now live (YEY!!!) 

After a highly successful launch onto Xbox One earlier this year, indie developer Cherry Pop Games has now delivered the ultimate billiards simulator Pool Nation FX, onto Steam's Early Access program. Available starting today, Pool Nation FX delivers a stunningly realistic on- or offline billiards experience, expanding upon the incredibly popular Xbox One release with a variety of new multiplayer features, trick shot mode, ruleset customization and more.

Developed with Unreal Engine 4, Pool Nation FX is available now for $12.99 and as a special limited-time bonus, owners of the original Pool Nation on Steam can purchase the game a discount of 30% off the game's full price

For more information, please visit - http://www.poolnationfx.com/ or buy Pool Nation FX now on Steam.

[list]
Pool Nation FX’s Key Features:
 [*] Customization 
 [*] Use the rule set customisation tool to create favorite game type using nine existing rule sets including; 9 Ball, 8 Ball, 8 Ball UK, Snooker, Killer and more 
 [*] Control your aim level settings; aiming aid off and on, novice through to pro 
 [*] Use the in-game currency to customize table baize, cues, balls and decals 
 [*] Raise, lower, and rotate trickshot objects on all axis in the artistic pool mode 
 [*] Adjustable difficulty levels in online and offline game modes 
 [*] Smooth physics and stunning graphics

Game Modes & Features:
 [*] Trickshots - Create unique trickshots with the artistic pool mode, including a variety of objects and special effects 
 [*] Leagues (Online competitive mode) - Players must climb the ladder and play with skill to avoid relegation to lower leagues 
 [*] Play for Cash – Online competitive mode. Players progress through  
[*] varying difficulty levels, the more coins you earn, the higher levels you unlock 
 [*] Friendlies – Invite friends to play online, customize your game type, rules, locations and more 
 [*] Versus – Offline game for one or two players. Play against the AI or locally against friends. 
 [*] Pool Career – Offline single-player career, start out in the qualifiers earn a place in the first cup. 
 [*] Snooker Career – Enjoy traditional Snooker, along with the standard billiards game types 
 [*] Daily Challenges – Play the daily game of 3 Ball to unlock a chance to win free coins, pot 3 balls to win a random daily prize 
 [*] Daily Trickshot Challenges – Complete the specific trickshot challenge to win coins. Each provides a selection of designated objects and effects to complete the task given 
 [*] Endurance – Keep sinking balls into pockets as they fall from above. Pot multiple balls in a row, or perform a skill shot and earn a ‘Drop Stop’ giving you a brief respite from the falling balls.

During the Steam Early Access development cycle, the following features will be added: 
Spectate, join and play matches seamlessly online in a digital Pool Nation Pool Hall 
Online Tournaments for 8 or more people 
Customizable PC specific controls for extra customisation

notes.title: Pool Nation FX STEAM Vs Xbox One?
notes.content:
So people keep asking - what's the difference between the Steam Version and the Xbox One version of Pool Nation FX...??

We know the difference between Pool Nation and the FX version (see my previous annoucment) so its a Good question! ːsteamhappyː

Firstly we received some great feedback from the 3 million downloads on Xbox One, so Steam in terms of the main game is further ahead in development than the current Xbox one version. We haven't stopped working on Pool Nation FX since its debut in April and will continue to long after its launch today on Steam. 

 [i]*To confirm before I start the comparison I will confirm that Xbox will get the Steam updates also![/i]
[list]
[*][b]Smaller file size[/b] on STEAM is 2.2GB 
[*]Pool Nation FX [b]loads quickly[/b] and smoothly at launch and in game
[*]Its smoother and more polished, due to the extra development time spent on the project, we have also updated the cameras to make it smoother. 
[*]Massive improvements to the difficulty levels of the AI. 
[*]Overhaul of the Snooker AI, to ensure they are playing to snooker rules
[*]The NEW collection is in - and collecting is fun: You compete to win, raise your profile and also your in game bank balance, but where do you spend it? There are cues, balls, decals, celebrations, locations and trickshot objects to spend your hard earned cash on. Your collection is yours to use, and there is a one stop shop in game to see what you've unlocked and what’s left to collect. 
[*]Endurance achievements have been made easier, they are now 3mins, 6mins, 9mins and 12mins so the time to hit is shorter and more achievable
[*]Manual drop-stop has been implemented in Endurance so you control when the drop stop happens or auto drop-stop can be selected 
[*]A new Endurance HUD now clearly shows when the next ball drops. 
[*]Characters in game to add atmosphere 
[*]All new TV screens in all locations to add life to to the venues 
[*]Crowd sounds controlled by a slider 
[*]Quicker to find online matches on Steam 
[*]General reported bug fixes. 
[*]Change game type in Practice - 8Ball, 9Ball and Snooker 
[*]Will also include the new Early Access features; the all new social hub of activity - the 'Pool Hall' the most exciting virtual Pool Hall you will find in a pool game. Leaderboards and workshop integration all coming soon to this early access version. 

Although Pool Nation FX on Steam addresses all of the main issues raised on Xbox one at launch and thereafter, it is in Early access for one main reason, the Pool Hall! This a social Mecca for billiards fans, and will be the most exciting social experience to hit a pool game - ever. It brings pool to life! We want to utilise the Steam forums to build this Pool Hall with you, hence the need for early access. The plan is to launch in three main stages:

Stage 1: introducing the pool hall and spectating matches live online  
Stage 2: Live information on current games in progress - Game state updates to give life to the pool hall experience 
Stage 3: Expanding the social experience - Winner stays on, bigger lobby's more people 

So as you can see we have far from finished with Pool Nation FX, its a great game that's about to get better! 

[i]*All updates to Pool Nation FX listed above are in test for Xbox One - the submission process for Xbox updates is a much longer process, hence why it is coming to Steam first. I just want to stress this as Xbox One hasn't been forgotten it just takes slightly longer to get to the same stage :) [/i]

This a social Mecca for billiards fans, and will be the most exciting social experience to hit a pool game - ever. It brings pool to life! We want to utilise the Steam forums to build this Pool Hall with you, hence the need for early access. The plan is to launch in three main stages:

Stage 1: introducing the pool hall and spectating matches live online  
Stage 2: Live information on current games in progress - Game state updates to give life to the pool hall experience 
Stage 3: Expanding the social experience - Winner stays on, bigger lobby's more people 

So as you can see we have far from finished with Pool Nation FX, its a great game that's about to get better!

I just want to stress this as Xbox One hasn't been forgotten it just takes slightly longer to get to the same stage :) [/i]
